user.title: NSPanel Lovelace Editor
user.description: Configure the path to your AppDaemon apps.yaml file. For HA OS/Supervised with the AppDaemon addon, the path is auto-detected. For container deployments where AppDaemon runs separately, you can leave the default and use paste-based import instead.

data_description.appdaemon_path: Full path to the AppDaemon apps.yaml file. Common paths: /addon_configs/a0d7b954_appdaemon/apps/apps.yaml (HA OS addon), /config/appdaemon/apps/apps.yaml (legacy addon or container with shared volume). If AppDaemon runs in a separate container without a shared volume mount, this path may not be reachable — use paste-based import instead.

abort.already_configured: NSPanel Lovelace Editor is already configured.

error.path_not_allowed: Path must be within an allowed directory (/config/, /addon_configs/, /homeassistant/, /share/).
